name: Bicol Express
description: Pork stewed in coconut milk with chilies and shrimp paste.

name: Laing
description: Taro leaves slow-cooked in coconut milk with chili.

name: Pinangat
description: Camalig's parcels of taro leaves wrapped around pork or shrimp, simmered in coconut milk with chili.

name: Kinalas
description: Noodle soup in a rich broth with shredded meat — from Naga, and popular across Albay.

name: Kinunot
description: Shredded stingray or fish in coconut milk with malunggay and chili.

name: Chicken tinutungan
description: Chicken cooked in "burnt" — toasted — coconut milk, for a deep, smoky flavour.

name: Lumpiang tinapa & kandingga
description: Smoked-fish spring rolls, and kandingga — a sour pork-offal stew.

name: Tinapa rice, pizza & pasta
description: Smoked fish worked into everyday staples.

name: Sili ice cream
description: Chili ice cream, invented by 1st Colonial Grill in 2004, with heat levels up to "Mayon". Try pili, malunggay or toasted-rice flavours too.

name: Daraga suman
description: Sticky glutinous-rice cakes steamed in banana leaves. Brgy. Tagas is famous for its makers (about ₱20 each in 2023 reports).
whereNote: Brgy. Tagas, the public market and LGU pasalubong fairs

name: Pili nut treats
description: Mazapan, pastillas, honey-glazed, roasted or salted pili, and pili tarts.

name: Sili latte & Bicolana latte
description: Local café twists — a latte with a chili kick, and a Bicolana house blend.
